ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXXIII OF
2002
An Ordinance to amend the Lahore the Council Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 22nd October, 2002]
No. Legis.13-54/2002, dated
22-10-2002.----The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Lahore Arts Council
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have to come into effect on and from the fourth day
of October, 2002.

Amendment in section 8 of Ordinance LXIII of 2002

No. Legis.13-54/2002, dated
22-10-2002.----The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
2. Amendment in section 8 of
Ordinance LXIII of 2002.--In the said Ordinance, in section 8 in subsection
(1)--
(i) after the word
"from" occurring for the .second time and before the word
"who" the words "a panel of twenty four individuals" shall
be substituted by the words "amongst those"; and
(ii) the words "The panel
shall be put up by the Department" shall be deleted.
